attractions.name: Dochula Pass
attractions.description: Popular stop on the Thimphu to Punakha road with 360 degree views of the Himalayas and 108 stupas built on a hill to celebrate victory against Indian rebels and commemorate soldiers lost in the 2003 battle.

attractions.name: Punakha Dzong
attractions.description: Stunning example of Bhutanese architecture at the fork of two rivers. Built in 1637, the second oldest and second largest fortress in Bhutan. Location of the 2011 royal wedding of King Jigme Khesar and Jetsun Pema.

attractions.name: Punakha Suspension Bridge
attractions.description: Longest suspension bridge in Bhutan, with views of the Po Chhu river (male river) and the valley. Ideal for photos.
tips: The area is popular for rafting

attractions.name: Chimi Lhakhang (Fertility Temple)
attractions.description: Popular temple on a small hillock, reached by a 15-minute walk through rice fields and a small village.

stops.name: Chimi Lhakhang
stops.suggested_stop: 15-minute walk through rice fields to the Fertility Temple

stops.name: Gangtey Goemba
stops.suggested_stop: Visit the monastery and nature trail
